description: Change a discount or access code (amount, uses, dates, scope); only the fields you pass are sent. Eventbrite: POST /discounts/{discount_id}/.

amount_off.description: Fixed amount off in the event currency, e.g. "10" or "7.50". Not together with percent_off.

end_date.description: Usable until, naive local time in the event's timezone, e.g. 2026-11-01T09:00:00.

event_id.description: Limit to one event. Omit (with ticket_group_id also omitted) for an organization-wide discount.

percent_off.description: Percentage off, 1.00–100.00, e.g. "20". Not together with amount_off.

quantity_available.description: How many times it can be used; 0 = unlimited.

start_date.description: Usable from, naive local time in the event's timezone, e.g. 2026-11-01T09:00:00.

ticket_class_ids.description: Limit to these ticket classes of event_id.

name: eventbrite_update_discount
title: Update a discount
